hints.title: Target Character Bitmask Representation
hints.text: The target word has length at most fifteen. Tracking which target character indices are covered via a bitmask allows fast state representation.

hints.title: First Uncovered Character Anchor
hints.text: To avoid symmetric duplicate paths, always choose a sticker that covers the first unfulfilled character in the target string.

hints.title: Subproblem Search and Transition Procedure
hints.text: Precompute letter frequency maps for each sticker. Identify the lowest unset bit in mask. Filter stickers that provide this character, simulate consumed characters from the sticker, and compute next bitmask. Memoize and return minimum stickers required.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input size or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(S * 2^T) time and O(2^T) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unconstrained recursive search explores an unbounded branching factor across repetitive stickers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask memoization on 2^|target| states with first-unset pruning runs in O(S * 2^T) time where T <= 15.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate must optimize sticker search by enforcing coverage of the first uncovered character to avoid duplicate permutations.
